The '''"Brute" strength enhancer''' was a type of [[Strength enhancing system/Legends|strength enhancing system]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Armor accessory|enhancement]] available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The system was produced by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] and cost 5500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="edge" />
